messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (PD-5872) — inference-prod: 5xx rate > 5% over 2m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-5872 

pagerbot: auto-ack failed to assign (rotation busy). Escalating to next on-call tier.

katie: on it — briefly stepping in to triage. grabbing logs now. @devon @raj if you see anything obvious plz shout. :hand: 

devon: acked and available. checking ingress & autoscaler dashboards. 

raj: 1min look — pushing a quick query to check recent deploys and model variants. 

katie: logs show a surge of 502s from transformer-runtime-1. Sample: ```ERROR: upstream read timeout
trace_id=1a2b3c
kvcache_miss=true
``` suspect KV cache thrash + an autoscaler oscillation. 

marcus: pinged Dedicated pool on-call as fallback; they confirm capacity is nominal. Do we want an immediate failover to fallback model variant? 

katie: yes — plan: (1) pin traffic to model v1.2-quant as fallback (lower perf but more stable), (2) temporarily widen autoscaler window to avoid thrash, (3) continue root-cause triage. I'll hand ownership to raj once traffic flip is done. 

raj: doing the traffic switch now. CLI snippet: ```redwoodctl traffic route --from variant=latest --to variant=v1.2-quant --weight=100 --dry-run=false``` 

incident-bot: traffic route completed, propagation ~10s. Monitoring for error rate. 

devon: error rate dropping from 5.3% -> 0.8% over 30s. Latency stable. Good signal. 

katie: handing off active ownership to raj — I need to jump to a customer meeting. raj, please keep posting 5m pings and escalate to Marcus if it reverts. @emma-cs FYI — potential customer impact for 12 customers (identified by request volume) while we investigate RCA. 

emma-cs: noted, will prepare a short customer message and wait for confirmation from eng. will ping support channel once we have final text. :white_check_mark: 

raj: on it — snapshotting runtime metrics and collecting heap/kvcache stats. current actions: collect logs (s3://redwood/logs/PD-5872/), keep traffic on v1.2-quant, monitor autoscaler flags. Next update in 5m. :eyes: 

pagerbot: PD-5872 auto-ack by raj. Escalation timer stopped. 

katie: thanks team — once we have RCA we'll create a postmortem and add mitigations (better kvcache backpressure + autoscaler hysteresis). tagging this thread for a follow-up doc. 

raj: 5m update — error rate 0.5%, no new deploys in window, kvcache eviction spikes aligned with high seq-length requests. preliminary hypothesis: sudden increase in long-context requests caused KV cache pressure + a tight autoscaler cooldown leading to transient upstream timeouts. will open a tracking ticket. 

marcus: if raj needs more hands for rollback or hotfix, say the word. Dedicated fallback can take partial traffic for critical customers. 

katie: good. quick action items: [1] raj open ticket with traces + query set; [2] devon propose autoscaler cooldown tweak; [3] eng-runtime to add kvcache backpressure heuristic. I'll schedule the postmortem. closing active page once ticket is created. 

raj: created TRACK-902 in infra board with links to logs and traces. closing PD-5872 with note: traffic pinned to v1.2-quant until follow-up. final status: mitigated, partial customer impact (12 affected), monitoring. 

incident-bot: PD-5872 marked resolved by raj. :white_check_mark:
